response.sql:
WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM group_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference
  FROM shares
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The missing ordersmark values form one group, as specified; the average share is the unweighted average across the resulting order reference groups.
